cast.name: 路易斯·海耶尔 Luise Heyer

introduction: Romy (28) and Sasha (26) are cousins. Both grew up in the Berlin like sisters with their mother-in-law mothers, Ina (49) and Michaela (46). Today is Sasha's birthday and as always, when there is something to celebrate, her grandmother Hanne lands with cheese pie in the hospital. Since they have decided not to tell their mothers anything about Hannes escapades, only the two are informed. Today both are called to the hospital. But this day is different. Torn between the lives of their mothers and the search for their own, Romy and Sasha start something new, far from the sense of responsibility
